title: Creamy Fruit Salad (Korean Style)
ldKeywords: creamy fruit salad, fruit salad, korean fruit salad
ldIngredientsRaw: 1  persimmon (, peeled, core & stem removed, cubed)
1  apple ((use red apple varieties), core removed, cubed)
1  roasted salted peanuts (or other nuts of your choice)
1 - 1.5 tsp honey (, adjust per your preference)
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine the dressing ingredients in a small bowl. Mix them well and set aside. Combine the main ingredients in a medium size mixing bowl. Pour over the salad dressing and gently toss to coat. Serve.
